column10: 2026-10-25: first real forward PHREEQC REACTION-path titration, built as the complement to the real inverse-modeling attempts on file (run_phreeqc_inverse(), inverse_config.csv rows lst_sbw0001_sbrr_2026/lst_sbs0001_sbrr_2026) -- every one of which finds zero feasible solutions within PHREEQC's automatic mass-balance search (see ROADMAP.md Section 1/2, 2026-10-25). Target = sample 821 (SBW_0001, the real across-creek Lower Sinter Terrace well showing a clear, repeatable deviation above the fissure+SBRR conservative-mixing curve on calcite/dolomite SI). End-members = 816 (SBF_0001 fissure, real thermal) and 819 (SBRR, Steamboat Creek @ Rhodes Road, real conservative/dilution reference -- itself carries a modest real thermal signature, Cl=17.1 mg/L, T=59.4C, so this is a conservative not theoretically pure meteoric analog, same caveat as the mixing/inverse runs using this same pair). Mixing fraction (0.5714) is looked up automatically from the already-stored lst_fissure_sbrr_2026 mixing run (mixing_config.csv), not recomputed. step_min_mol/step_max_mol left blank so run_reaction_path_titration()'s own .estimate_reaction_bounds_mol() auto-sizes the range from the mixed fluid's real Ca/Mg/Alkalinity content (asymmetric: a real physical limit on the precipitation/negative side, a generous 6x-wider default on the dissolution/positive side, confirmed empirically 2026-10-25 to find a genuine interior RMSE minimum rather than an artifact at the range's own edge). Real result (scratch-DB verification, 2026-10-25): best-fit net reaction progress is a small net DISSOLUTION of calcite+dolomite (~+1.17e-4 mol combined), reducing the combined Ca/Mg/Alkalinity RMSE from ~45-48% (near-zero reaction progress, i.e. pure conservative mixing) to ~23% at the best fit -- a real, substantial improvement over pure mixing, but not a full reconciliation (consistent with -- not contradicting -- the inverse model's own finding that simple two-end-member-plus-carbonate mixing cannot fully explain SBW_0001's chemistry). Cl stays exactly conservative across every step (0.0000% variation), confirming the titration only moves carbonate species as intended.
